items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: The one you're talking about, they made them for Spikes Brothers.

ctx.x: But I mean way back in 1921.

The first record I made was for Good Time Jazz. You never made those real old ones then? No, I think the first one I made was for Decker. The one you're talking about, they made them for Spikes Brothers.
Yeah, some real old ones, Dink Johnson. Yeah, no, I wasn't on that, no. Martin, Oliver, that's right.
